title: On Waterfront Blocks
previewText: For uses on waterfront blocks, as defined in Section 62-11, the special accessory off-street parking and loading regulations set forth in Section 62-40, inclusive, shall apply. When any use is permitted in both the designated Residence District and the designated M1 District, the accessory off-street parking and loading requirements applicable to the designated M1 District shall apply to such use.
